text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Yamanin 
Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction she was facing, 
there was a crane game filled with 
plushies designed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Blocked by the glass, I can't feel 
the wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If only I could help them and let them 
feel the wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I do not possess much experience in the 
matter, so I am certain it would prove 
utterly futile.
choice_data_list: Shall I get it for you?
Shall I get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? By all means, please do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
